measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potentials of MPs were approximately -20 mV in water, PFA solution, and PSF solution. In the SPP medium, it increased to -10 mV. || The ζ-potential and hydrodynamic diameter of the MPs were measured using a Zetasizer (Nano series, Malvern Instruments, U.K.). || Additionally, the stability of the Cy5 dye label was evaluated by incubating the MPs in sterile proteose peptone-based (SPP) medium (2% (w/v) proteose peptone, 0.1% (w/v) yeast extract, 0.2% (w/v) glucose, 0.003% (w/v) ferric citrate, and 1% (v/v) penicillin-streptomycin), PFA solution, and phagolysosomal simulant fluid (PSF) (see Table S1 for composition), respectively, during the typical exposure period.
measurements.evidence_location: Results, Characterization of Fluorescently Labeled MPs; Methods, Characterization of MPs
